_note: Shared input cases for the HiGy.R 0.4.0 fixture harness, first written 11 September 2026. ONE source of inputs read by both parity_python_050.py and parity_r_050.R so the two sides cannot drift on what they were asked. Every tree list below is synthetic and was written for this harness. It contains no plot coordinates, no plot identifiers and no observation from the FIA record.

cases.label: A_low_nat_treeeq
cases.why: low SDI, gate scales the rate DOWN (p below p_bar), A1 natural floor scaled with it

cases.label: B_low_plt_treeeq
cases.why: same tree list, planted, so the gate carries the origin offset

cases.label: C_mid_nat_treeeq
cases.why: mid SDI, gate close to neutral (p close to p_bar), natural

cases.label: E_high_nat_treeeq
cases.why: high SDI, gate scales the rate UP (p above p_bar), natural

cases.label: G_low_nat_relsize
cases.why: as-published relative-size weight on the A tree list

cases.label: H_mid_nat_relsize
cases.why: as-published weight on the C tree list

cases.label: I_high_plt_relsize
cases.why: as-published weight on the F tree list, planted

cases.label: J_flat_nat_treeeq
cases.why: no QMD growth, natural A1 floor reached then scaled UP by the gate

cases.label: K_flat_plt_treeeq
cases.why: no QMD growth, planted A1 floor reached then scaled UP by the gate

cases.label: L_surge_nat_treeeq
cases.why: substantial stand rate, no cap binding, fitted survivor weight

cases.label: M_surge_nat_relsize
cases.why: same stand, as-published weight, so the two Stage 3 weights are compared on identical input

cases.label: N_capbind_nat_treeeq
cases.why: stand rate below the 0.95 cap but the PER-TREE cap binds, so the lambda bisection runs

cases.label: O_capbind_nat_relsize
cases.why: same stand, as-published weight, lambda bisection runs on a wider weight spread

cases.label: P_clip_nat_treeeq
cases.why: gated rate hits the 0.95 clip, allocation infeasible, both sides warn and put every tree at the cap

cases.label: Q_nosdi_nat_treeeq
cases.why: SDI not available, gate passes the rate through UNGATED on both sides

cases.label: R_ungated_nat_treeeq
cases.why: gate switched off explicitly, recovers the ungated 0.4.0 stand rate on the E tree list
